Alley dining excellence in HCM
May 2023 • Family
A new place to dine in Ho Chi Minh City. We often wander among this alley and have a few quiet beers. From time to time we try one if the restaurants.
This time we stopped here stopped to try a cocktail as they have a happy hour and have a look at the menu while we relaxed. 
We decided to sit inside in the aircon even though it wasn't that hot outside tonight.
The menu has just about the right amount of items so it's not overwhelming.
We thought about the garlic bread as we had been missing a bit of western food but instead 2 of us went for the pho ba and our son ordered the loc-lak beef.
The pho was very nice. It has that slightly sweet taste of southern Vietnam and was big enough of a serve for the climate. 
The Loc Lac was also tasty.
Service was attentive but as westerners we like to have our drinks ordered then left for about 5 minutes to think about what we want to eat. Generally in Vietnam they ask what you want to eat as soon as you sit. We just asked for a few minutes to think about our orders. No problems just a difference in culture.
The drinks were excellent and tasted correct to it palate. We do enjoy a cocktail with our meal. Very indulgent.
We enjoyed our meal here and would come back again. 
Thanks for the great experience.
